question: Related Questions Q. I am a sunni muslim boy, I want to marry a sunni muslim girl but her parents are not ready.Please Tell me some dua so that I can marry her. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 44955 Country: India Title: Islamic views about marriage and sharing bed Question: I am getting married in June and later Ramadan starts, I would like to know can we share bed during Ramadan or when we observe fast also or what is Islamic view/restrictions about it. Also adding on the question can we have oral sex? Answer ID: 44955 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 751/454/L=1434) It is lawful to sleep with wife and have sex during the night of Ramadan. Likewise it is also lawful to sleep with her during day time and have foreplay with her. However, if by foreplay one fears ejaculation or falling in intercourse then it is necessary to avoid foreplay. Oral sex is makrooh and bestiality. [M] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
